Compete against motorcycles of 250cc, 550cc, and 750cc in different tracks full of obstacles and the best riders. Skills aren't going to be enough to win. Throughout the race you will find items that will give you power ups to help you beat your opponents. Use them to your advantage! Compete against a friend in 2 player mode (split screen) and discover once and for all who is the best Moto X racer. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionTake control of Sproutrex, a small nature-powered mechanical sphere equipped with a propeller, and explore a colorful pixel-art world where plants and machines have grown together. Run, jump, glide and fly your way through 28 handcrafted levels filled with hazards, enemies, moving platforms and environmental challenges. Use Sproutrex's unique abilities to reach new areas, overcome dangerous obstacles and discover different ways through each stage. Along the way, collect coins and mechanical seeds hidden throughout the levels. Find every seed in a stage to earn its Perfect Level medal and prove you've mastered the challenge. But Sproutrex is more than just a machine. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionStart your own diecast car store and turn a small shop into the place every collector visits. Buy sealed surprise boxes from eight Supercar series – Basic, Faster, Pro, Elite, Champion, Master, Extra and Ultra – and open them at your unboxing table. Every box hides a random set of cars, from common runs to the rarest Special editions. Keep the ones you love in your personal collection, or put them on the shelves, set a price and sell them to the collectors who walk through your door. Build the store you want. Add shelves, racing platforms, vending machines and bundle tables. Change floors and walls, hang posters, name your shop and grow it from a single room into a full showroom. Hire cashiers, sales clerks and warehouse workers, manage your stock and watch the store statistics and customer reviews to see what sells. Race on the shop floor. Set up racing platforms, let customers challenge you on the track and win prize money, or take the wheel yourself in test drives. Skill cards give you an edge in every race, and you can sell skill card packs to your customers too. Complete the collection. Visit the Hunt House to track down the cars you are missing, trade with the Black Market for rare finds and exclusive deals, and try your luck at the betting tables. Make it yours. Choose a car, paint it, cover it with stickers, design its card, give it a name and put it up for sale. Every car you create is one of a kind. More than 800 cars are waiting to be unboxed.
